# Trader Kavach

Trader Kavach is a trading risk management and capital planning platform for traders.

Website: https://traderkavach.in/

Core topics and tools:
- Trading risk calculator
- Position size calculator
- Forex risk calculator
- XAUUSD / gold trading risk planning
- Risk-reward calculation
- Trading capital management
- Trading plan
- Trading journal

Public educational pages are listed in the XML sitemap. Trader Kavach provides calculation and planning tools and is not financial advice.
